"""Reply drafts for the support inbox, written with the OpenAI Responses API."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from openai import OpenAI

DRAFT_MODEL = "gpt-5.5"
TAG_MODEL = "gpt-5.5-mini"
MAX_DRAFT_TOKENS = 400

STYLE_GUIDE = (
    "You write e-mail replies for the Northwind Cloud support team. Be friendly and concrete, "
    "use at most three short paragraphs, and never promise refunds or credits."
)
TAGS = ("billing", "outage", "account", "feature-request", "other")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Ticket:
    id: str
    subject: str
    body: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Draft:
    ticket_id: str
    text: str
    truncated: bool


def suggest_tag(client: OpenAI, ticket: Ticket) -> str:
    """One tag from TAGS for the ticket ("other" when the model answers anything else)."""
    response = client.responses.create(
        model=TAG_MODEL,
        instructions="Classify the support ticket. Answer with exactly one word from: " + ", ".join(TAGS) + ".",
        input=f"{ticket.subject}\n\n{ticket.body}",
        max_output_tokens=16,
        store=False,
    )
    tag = response.output_text.strip().lower()
    return tag if tag in TAGS else "other"


def draft_reply(client: OpenAI, ticket: Ticket) -> Draft:
    raise NotImplementedError

from types import SimpleNamespace

from app.drafts import DRAFT_MODEL, MAX_DRAFT_TOKENS, STYLE_GUIDE, Ticket, draft_reply

TICKET = Ticket(id="T-88", subject="Charged twice", body="My card was charged twice for September.")


class FakeResponses:
    def __init__(self, text, status="completed", reason=None):
        self.response = SimpleNamespace(
            output_text=text,
            status=status,
            incomplete_details=SimpleNamespace(reason=reason) if reason else None,
        )
        self.calls = []

    def create(self, **kwargs):
        self.calls.append(kwargs)
        return self.response


def test_draft_reply_sends_the_expected_request():
    responses = FakeResponses("  Hi there,\n\nSorry about that.\n")
    draft = draft_reply(SimpleNamespace(responses=responses), TICKET)

    assert draft.ticket_id == "T-88"
    assert draft.text == "Hi there,\n\nSorry about that."
    assert draft.truncated is False
    call = responses.calls[0]
    assert call["model"] == DRAFT_MODEL
    assert call["instructions"] == STYLE_GUIDE
    assert "Charged twice" in call["input"] and "charged twice for September" in call["input"]
    assert call["max_output_tokens"] == MAX_DRAFT_TOKENS
    assert call["store"] is False
    assert call["metadata"] == {"ticket_id": "T-88"}


def test_draft_hitting_the_token_cap_is_truncated():
    responses = FakeResponses("Hi there, sorry", status="incomplete", reason="max_output_tokens")
    assert draft_reply(SimpleNamespace(responses=responses), TICKET).truncated is True


def test_other_incomplete_reasons_are_not_truncation():
    responses = FakeResponses("Hi", status="incomplete", reason="content_filter")
    assert draft_reply(SimpleNamespace(responses=responses), TICKET).truncated is False

    assert call["max_output_tokens"] == MAX_DRAFT_TOKENS
    assert call["store"] is False
    assert call["metadata"] == {"ticket_id": "T-88"}


def test_draft_hitting_the_token_cap_is_truncated():
    responses = FakeResponses("Hi there, sorry", status="incomplete", reason="max_output_tokens")
    assert draft_reply(SimpleNamespace(responses=responses), TICKET).truncated is True


def test_other_incomplete_reasons_are_not_truncation():
    responses = FakeResponses("Hi", status="incomplete", reason="content_filter")
    assert draft_reply(SimpleNamespace(responses=responses), TICKET).truncated is False
